(Chance: 20%) No effect in [[PvP]]. :[[Enchantment]]s last 20% longer :[[Health]] +30 :Crafted in tribute to an enduring legend. ==Skin== It uses the [[Earth Staff (obsidian)]] [[skin]]. This skin is normally exclusive to the [[Earth Magic]] attribute. ==Replica== This item cannot be replicated, as the universal "20% chance of halving casting time of spells" mod is not available outside of the unique Decade weapons. Except [[Spiritbinder]] and the [[Hourglass Staff]], other staves with requirements in Spawning Power or Channeling Magic deal [[lightning damage]] instead of dark damage. ==Notes== *The [[auto attack]] [[projectile]]s fired by this staff are identical to those used by [[Attack spirit|attack spirits]]. *Like other equipment with multiple attribute requirements, the damage property will count once no matter how many different requirements are met. *The inherent bonus [[HCT]] effect during events is only active during certain events ([[Canthan New Year]], [[Anniversary Celebration]], [[Dragon Festival]], [[Wayfarer's Reverie]], [[Halloween]], and [[Wintersday]]). ==Trivia== *Introduced in the [[Feedback:Game updates/20150422|April 22, 2015 update]]. {{Decade weapons nav}} [[Category:Decade weapons|Staff]] [[Category:Unreplicable unique items]] [[Category:Multiple attribute items]]
